reasoning: This repository is a benchmarking and performance testing tool for the llm-d inference stack. It provides a CLI (`llmdbenchmark`) that automates the full lifecycle of LLM inference benchmarks: infrastructure standup, workload deployment, experiment execution with Design of Experiments (DoE) parameter sweeps, result collection, and teardown. It is not an operator (no CRDs or controller-runtime), not a library consumed by other code (it's a standalone CLI tool), not a service (no long-running server), and not pure configuration. It is best classified as a benchmarking/testing tool that orchestrates Kubernetes deployments and runs inference performance experiments across multiple environments (GKE, Coreweave, OpenShift).
